name: nfactory-forge
description: nFactory-Forge Agent (fork of super-board 3.1.2). Autonomous GitHub Project board runner. Primary skills: nfactory-forge, forge-build, forge-qa, forge-review, forge-collect. Secondary skills: visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop. Installed as a plugin it ships the skills only; run /nfactory-forge onboard to add the guard hooks, .claude/bin scripts and workflows (get.sh / install.sh install all of it in one go).
